threads.body: `gen_ai.output.messages` requires `finish_reason` to be a string (see `model/gen-ai/gen-ai-output-messages.json`, where `finish_reason` is required and does not allow null). This code can emit JSON with `"finish_reason": null` when `finish_reason` is unavailable, which will fail strict conformance schema validation.

`gen_ai.response.finish_reasons` is derivable from the Responses `status`/`incomplete_details` (you already have `_fetch_response_finish_reason()` below). With the current `if response.status == "completed"` guard, non-`completed` terminal responses (e.g. `incomplete`, `failed`) will omit `gen_ai.response.finish_reasons` even though a meaningful value can be recorded, which is likely to surface as a strict-mode missing-attribute violation.
